results.rationale: Consistency: white background remains, but both surviving cans have substantially changed size, proportions, positions and label layouts; the overall arrangement is rebuilt. Instruction: three cans become two. A perfect removal leaves two cola containers; treating bottle as the visibly supplied can, exactly one is removed, so compliance is complete. Quality: can silhouettes and metallic rims are coherent, but the large can has distorted ZERO SUGAR lettering and garbled lower markings, while the small can has malformed lower label text; these multiple text artifacts impair the product rendering.

Consistency: the white background and three-can row remain, but the cans are reduced and repositioned, the left logo is visibly distorted, and its lower white nutrition badge is lost. Instruction: all three cans remain. The expected result is two cola containers after one removal; no container is removed, so the instruction is not followed. Quality: cylinders, rims, lighting and background are plausible, but the left can has a conspicuous smeared and doubled-looking black logo region; remaining major lettering and surfaces are coherent.

Consistency: the white background remains, but the surviving container is repositioned, elongated and recolored pale pink with red lettering, with extensively altered label details. Instruction: three cans become one. The expected result after removing one is two containers; removal is present but its quantity is wrong, giving partial compliance. Quality: the can outline and silver rims are plausible, but ZERRO SUGAR, the malformed end of the calorie line, the white badge and lower volume/nutrition markings contain multiple conspicuous lettering artifacts.

Consistency: white background and a row of three red cans remain, but can dimensions and positions change, the middle can becomes washed out with altered top geometry, and logos and lower labeling are changed. Instruction: three cans are still visible. A successful single removal would leave two; fading and deforming the middle container does not remove it, so compliance fails. Quality: the middle can has a smeared logo, garbled text and an unnatural flat speckled upper rim; boundaries between cans blend together, producing multiple distracting structural and texture artifacts.
